_note: Role -> model policy (single source of truth). Skills and hooks reference these defaults instead of hardcoding model names. Rationale: decisions/2026-07-02-100946 (12-cell measurement: sonnet 10/10 in all conditions; haiku sole misses). design=inherit keeps the session model (fable/opus) for conversation, design, and exception judgment. summarize=sonnet for faithful transcript->template summarization (the idle-checkpoint background fork): the cost motive rules out opus, and sonnet is measured to pass where haiku is the sole miss. verify_external is a different-vendor judge for cross-check.sh (decisions/2026-07-10-070500): a separate provider mitigates self-preference bias, and multi-agent deliberation is deliberately not adopted (it can amplify bias), so this stays a single-shot refutation review. cost_optimized_nda_ok=false because DeepSeek documents in-China data processing, which the PII protection rule forbids for NDA engagements. Owner decision (2026-07-10): OpenRouter is not adopted as a paid contract, so verify_external prioritizes each user's own subscription CLI (codex, then gemini) and keeps openrouter as an API-key fallback only; claude is excluded from auto-detection as a same-vendor judge (self-preference bias) and requires explicit opt-in.
